facts.fact: Communications Minister Sam George said the Data Protection Commission has full authorization to penalize state bodies and has already issued official cautions to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and to Parliament.

GHA.note: Cautions are undated and not shown as a decision or order, so no rulings fact.

facts.fact: Minister Sam George said the government is working with the Data Protection Commission and Parliament to update the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), to address risks such as AI and cross-border transfers.
The Data Protection Commission is acting under the Act: the minister said it can penalize state bodies and has cautioned the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Parliament.

The minister said official cautions had been issued by the Data Protection Commission to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs over leaked evacuee records and to Parliament over a Select Committee's mishandling of citizen data.
